requirements.evidence: Pinned PKHeX X/Y Standard areas are decoded with the pk3DS XYWE slot order (grass, yellow/purple/red flowers, rough terrain, Surf, Rock Smash, Old/Good/Super Rod); Horde and ambush areas stay separate. The decode reproduces 563 of the 566 pinned PokéAPI X wild location-species-method triples outside Friend Safari; the other three (Route 13 Dugtrio, Trapinch, Gible ground ambush) are present in the same area as rough-terrain slots.

Code-defined static, gift, fossil, in-game trade and Friend Safari rows come from pinned PKHeX Encounters6XY; Kalos starters, Kanto starters and the Glittering Cave fossil are exclusive choice groups; calendar trash-can, roaming-bird and daily-trader rows stay conditional and rank below ordinary encounters.

Every X/Y encounter location maps to an authored chapter token or override. Old Rod (Ambrette, ch2), Good Rod (Coumarine, ch4), Super Rod (Route 16, ch7), Surf (ch3), TM94 Rock Smash (Ambrette, ch2) and the postgame locations Kiloude City, Friend Safari, Unknown Dungeon and Sea Spirit's Den gate each row.

Concrete PKHeX form indexes are preserved per slot; Vivillon/Scatterbug and Flabébé dynamic sentinels become the base form with explicit conditions, and form profiles resolve PokéAPI form order for Korean names, types and stats.
Learnsets and evolution rows are read per resolved PokéAPI pokemon identifier; form learnsets are never unioned.
Version group 15 preserves unfiltered level, egg, tutor and machine rows for 784 separate Pokemon identifiers.

Level-up moves use the chapter level ranges; HMs and TM94 Rock Smash use the verified field-move chapters; other reusable TMs follow the Gen 1–5 contract and are labelled inferred at 70% of the main story; egg and tutor moves are excluded from recommendations because their acquisition is not modelled.

Version-group 15 evolution rows win over other generations: Magnezone/Probopass at Route 13, Leafeon at Route 20, Glaceon at Frost Cavern, Sylveon by affection, Goodra in overworld rain, Tyrantrum by day and Aurorus by night; trade and held-item trade evolutions set tradeRequired.

Evolution stones use cross-checked earliest chapters (Leaf Route 8 ch2; Thunder Route 10/11 ch3; Moon Reflection Cave ch3; Dawn Route 3 by Surf ch3; Water and Shiny Route 12 ch4; Fire Stone Emporium ch5; Dusk Terminus Cave ch9); stones without a confirmed location fall back to the final main-story chapter and are labelled inferred.

All eight Gyms, Lysandre's final Team Flare Secret HQ battle (Lv.49–53), the Elite Four (Lv.63–65) and Diantha (Lv.64–68) carry verified levels and party types; rival and admin battles are not modelled as planner bosses, the same contract as the Gen 1–5 families.
Postgame locations and conditions are separated from the Champion path, and Kanto starter, Kalos fossil and legendary-bird choices are exclusive choice groups.
Cut, Strength, Surf and Waterfall are required; Fly and Rock Smash are optional traversal aids with version-group legality.
X and Y are GameConfig entries backed by the kalos6 family with form-aware member keys and unchanged pokemon-roadmap:v3 persistence.
Regression tests generate X and Y parties for every Kalos starter and check exclusive choices, version exclusives and roadmap references.

Pinned PKHeX ORAS Standard areas are decoded with the pk3DS RSWE slot order (grass, long grass, three DexNav-only slots, Surf, Old/Good/Super Rod); Rock Smash and Horde areas stay separate. The decode reproduces all 78 pinned PokéAPI ORAS wild location-species-method triples outside Mirage spots. Walk slots on the water routes 107, 124, 126, 128, 129 and 130 are underwater seaweed encounters gated by Dive, and DexNav-only slots hold non-Hoenn species gated behind the National Pokédex.

Code-defined static, gift, egg, fossil, trade and Cosplay Pikachu rows come from pinned PKHeX Encounters6AO. Meteor Falls areas beyond the first Standard and Horde tables require Waterfall; Mirage spots and soaring statics require the Eon Flute after the primal battle; Devon Scope Kecleon appear in Lavaridge after the primal battle and in Mossdeep only during the Delta Episode. Legendary statics whose party or Mirage prerequisites are unverified, Sea Mauville Spiritomb and Eon Ticket rows are excluded from recommendations.
Cosplay Pikachu forms 1–6 are one exclusive gift choice with form-specific learnsets; Mega and Primal forms are battle-only and never become planner members.
Version group 16 preserves unfiltered level, egg, tutor and machine rows for 811 separate Pokemon identifiers.

Level-up moves use chapter level ranges; the seven HMs use the verified field-move chapters; other reusable TMs follow the Gen 1–5 contract and are labelled inferred at 70% of the main story; Battle Resort and other tutors plus egg moves are excluded from recommendations.

Version-group 16 evolution rows win: Magnezone/Probopass at New Mauville (after the primal battle), Leafeon at Petalburg Woods, Glaceon at Shoal Cave and Milotic by Pokéblock Beauty (Pokéblock Kit in Slateport). Evolution stones use cross-checked chapters: Fire (Fiery Path with Strength) and Moon (Meteor Falls) ch4, Dawn (Sea Mauville) ch5, Leaf (Route 119) ch6, Shiny (Route 121) and Dusk (Mt. Pyre) ch7, Sun (Mossdeep Space Center) and Water (Route 124 Treasure Hunter) ch8, Thunder (New Mauville) ch9.

All eight Gyms (Roxanne Lv.12–14 through Wallace Lv.44–46), the versioned Seafloor Cavern Maxie/Archie battle (Lv.41–43), the Elite Four (Lv.50–55) and Steven (Lv.57–59) carry verified levels and party types; rival battles are not modelled as planner bosses, the same contract as the Gen 1–5 families. The Delta Episode, Battle Resort and Sky Pillar are postgame.
Cut, Rock Smash, Strength, Surf, Dive and Waterfall story use is separated from optional Fly.
Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire are GameConfig entries backed by the hoenn6 family with form-aware member keys, unchanged pokemon-roadmap:v3 persistence and regression tests for every Hoenn starter.

Pinned PokéAPI Sun/Moon rows supply the ordinary grass, Surf, Fishing Rod, bubbling-spot, SOS and berry-pile methods with PokéAPI pokemon identifiers mapped to PKHeX form indexes. PKHeX species/forms missing from PokéAPI at the same location are added only as method-unresolved rows gated behind the Lapras Paddle and Fishing Rod (chapter 2) and ranked below ordinary encounters. Missing encounter rates alone do not block promotion.

Alola starters (choice group) and the Paniola Ranch Eevee egg are modelled, together with the story Solgaleo/Lunala at the altar. Wild Ultra Beasts and Necrozma are postgame. Island Scan needs real QR codes, and Poké Pelago visitors, statics, gifts and in-game trades without verified prerequisites are excluded from recommendations.
Alolan forms, Oricorio styles and other concrete forms keep their PKHeX form index; Totem and battle-only forms never become planner members.

Version group 17 form-identifier level and TM rows are read per resolved form. Level-up moves use chapter level ranges and the join-level moveset; reusable TMs follow the Gen 1–5 contract and are labelled inferred at 70% of the main story; tutors and egg moves are excluded from recommendations.

Alola evolution rows (Alolan forms, Blush Mountain Magnezone/Probopass/Vikavolt, Lush Jungle Leafeon, Mount Lanakila Glaceon/Crabominable, Stomp-known Tsareena, day/night Lycanroc and night Alolan Marowak) are used; Konikoni City sells Fire, Thunder, Water, Leaf and Ice Stones (ch3), Sun Stone is at Malie and Moon Stone on Route 13 (ch4), Dusk Stone in Poni Wilds (ch6), and the Dawn Stone is postgame.

Totem, Kahuna (Hala Lv.14–15), both Lusamine battles, Elite Four and Kukui (Lv.56–58) battles carry verified levels and party types; rival and Team Skull battles are not modelled as planner bosses, the same contract as the Gen 1–5 families.
Poké Ride traversal is modeled without requiring party HM moves.
Sun and Moon are GameConfig entries backed by the alola7 family with form-aware member keys, unchanged pokemon-roadmap:v3 persistence and regression tests for every Alola starter.
